integrity_notes: Classical continuous/discrete self-decomposability criteria and the published PNXL generating function are acknowledged as prior work; the proposed new contribution is the exact phase comparison and the full factorial-Palm critical family. Independent audit has not been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns two common-rate gamma components of adjacent shapes, and binomial thinning only; finite rational checks corroborate but do not prove infinite inequalities. The original PNXL article was accessible in indexed sections, but its complete publisher PDF was unavailable for exhaustive priority comparison.
title: Poissonization restores thinning self-decomposability in adjacent-gamma mixtures
